scope: Read-only same-investigation review, source/hash/AST comparisons and authored qualification receipt inspection. No empirical outputs, annotations, inference, matching run or independent-science claim.
checks: New three profiles require explicit resource-qualified wrapper identities and original exact first-pair profile is retained.
Literal gate code is hash-bound and replays exact outer/returned/persisted receipt plus journal, log, policy and capacity constraints.
Actual wrapper evidence paths, frozen component roster, runtime status, all312 tensor count, exact source/image/protocol/model identities are bound.
Nested numerical report must be complete with no failure, orphan raw arrays or terminal refusal; missing is never coerced into empty.
Successful consumer execution requires exact schema, returncode0, timed_out false, matching report digest, exact component pins and command.
Source matching/checker AST equals prior0.6 after version literal normalization; maxflow and native dependency list byte-identical.
Complete four-image/twelve-case roster, exact rational loss, native caps and G/P composition retained.

authored_qualification_inspected.preserved_initial_failure: Correct journal rejection had a wrong expected diagnostic substring; prior source and receipt retained.

limits: The resource wrapper and gate share provenance; no wholly fabricated internally consistent history can be authenticated by hashes alone.
